within_year_ranking: descending frozen out-of-time predicted loss probability, deterministic node_id lexical tie-break
outputs: precision lift over unstratified event prevalence
net additional events captured and changed watchlist members from node to node_quant
rules: No probability refitting, no capacity selection based on outcomes, no year deletion
All metrics are descriptive and exploratory; no formal p value or positive claim threshold
AUC/log-loss improvement is not evidence of useful alarm precision by itself
Site-saturated comparator is required; report space results only as legacy comparator
No capacity limited watchlist is promoted before actual results of the node saturated audit are confirmed and externally validated
Recorded absence does not imply plant mortality; alert capture is not treatment effect or ecosystem function
